name: Plaguewood
summary: Scarlet Crusaders patrol Plaguewood, where the Scourge gathers south of Stratholme. Greenwood has become a blighted forest choked with fungus.

sections.title: From Greenwood to Decay
sections.body: Before the Third War, Greenwood was a forest much like Elwynn's lush woods. A modest village stood by its entrance, and farmers and soldiers traveled the roads. Then tainted grain came from Andorhal, and the woodland fell. Rich earth turned to spongy, corrupted soil. Huge mushrooms now dwarf the dead trees and spread noxious brown vapors over the forest floor.

sections.title: A Bastion of the Dead
sections.body: The Scourge has taken Plaguewood and made it a staging ground for the undead around Stratholme. Ziggurats and slaughterhouses dot the ruined land, producing abominations and cultists. Scarlet Crusaders patrol the road to Stratholme's gates, bent on purging the Scourge. They also slaughter any living travelers they meet.

faq.q: What was this forest called before the plague?
faq.answer: Before the Third War, the forest was called Greenwood. A small village stood near its entrance, and its woods resembled Elwynn Forest in beauty and climate.

faq.q: Why are there massive mushrooms growing everywhere?
faq.answer: The plague warped the forest's soil and growth. Monstrous fungi now rise from the spongy ground and belch noxious brown clouds like those from plague cauldrons.
The Scourge holds most of Plaguewood, with necromancers, ghouls, ziggurats, and slaughterhouses. Scarlet Crusader patrols march along the main roads, attacking undead and living travelers on sight.

faq.q: Where does the road through the woods lead?
faq.answer: The main road runs north to the gates of Stratholme. Westward, the blighted woods reach toward the ruined village of Terrordale.

angles.text: As a paladin, you face abominations and unyielding fanatics among Plaguewood's twisted trees and foul cauldrons. The land recalls Lordaeron's fall and tests your devotion to the Light.
As an Alliance survivor, you walk the road Prince Arthas took toward the purge of Stratholme. Rot and mad Scarlet zealots line the way.
